verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine with a CLI (`cactus run`, `cactus convert`, `cactus benchmark`), so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows CLI flags for GPU offload or context length. Community reports say the GPU isn't used for inference on a Pixel or on Apple GPU (Needle 3), and the vendor stresses 'no GPU' operation, so custom GPU offload settings are not evidenced.
